sentences.text: Sri Rakesh Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Bipin Bihari, learned counsel for the opposite party nos.2 and 3 and Sri Karunakar Singh, learned A.G.A. are present.

The present transfer application has been filed to transfer the Case No. 5363 of 2022 (State vs. Udai Pratap Singh and others), under Section 498A, 323, 504 IPC arising out of Case Crime No. 0042 of 2021, pending in the court of A.C.J.M., Court No.II, Budaun to the competent court of Mau Judgeship.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is wife of opposite party no.2 and marriage of applicant with opposite party no.2 was solemnized on 07.02.2021 and FIR was lodged on 24.11.2021.

It is further submitted that two other cases being Case No. 809 of 2021 (Smt. Alka Smt Alka Rani vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 16 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119744587/
1 Rani vs. Udai Pratap Singh), under Section 125 Cr.P.C., pending in the court of Principal Judge,
Family Court, Mau and Case No. 11638 of 202 (Alka Rani vs. Udai Pratap Singh and others), under Section 12 of The Protection of Woman From Domestic Violence Act, pending the in court of Special Judicial Magistrate/FTC, Mau are pending in Mau Judgeship between the parties.
